title: matelea tristis
intro: Matelea tristis, commonly known as the "sad wisteria," is a species of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. As a medicinal plant, Matelea tristis has been used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Matelea tristis involve its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Matelea tristis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
